The maxilla grows by apposition at its various circummaxillary sutures, including the frontomaxillary, nasomaxillary, zygomaticomaxillary, and pterygomaxillary sutures. Growth at these sutures contributes significantly to the downward and forward displacement of the maxilla, thereby increasing its height and length.D) The intermaxillary suture closes about eight years postnatally. This statement is incorrect. The intermaxillary (midpalatal) suture remains open and active for growth well into adolescence and often into early adulthood.
